title: Monkey dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M68 70 Q86 66 84 48 Q82 36 72 38' fill='none' stroke='#8B4513' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <path d='M40 74 L34 90' stroke='#A0522D' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 74 L70 86' stroke='#A0522D' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='92' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#C68642'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='88' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#C68642'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='19' ry='19' fill='#A0522D'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='12' ry='13' fill='#E8B27A'/>
  <!-- left arm raised -->
  <path d='M34 52 L20 34' stroke='#A0522D' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='31' r='7' fill='#C68642'/>
  <!-- right arm raised -->
  <path d='M66 52 L82 36' stroke='#A0522D' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='33' r='7' fill='#C68642'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='18' fill='#A0522D'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='26' r='6' fill='#C68642'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='26' r='6' fill='#C68642'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='31' rx='13' ry='14' fill='#E8B27A'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='26' r='3' fill='#3B2314'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='26' r='3' fill='#3B2314'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='25' r='1' fill='#FFE9C9'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='25' r='1' fill='#FFE9C9'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M43 37 Q50 43 57 37' fill='none' stroke='#8B4513' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='33' r='1.5' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='33' r='1.5' fill='#8B4513'/>
</svg>
